name: Short Cut Beef "Souvlaki" Skewers with Zucchini, Red Onion, Tzatziki & Pita

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Wash, dry, and trim zucchini, then slice crosswise into 1/2-inch thick rounds. Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Cut steak into bite sized pieces. Thread veggies and steak onto skewers, alternating ingredients. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
1 medium red onion
12 oz striploin (New York strip) steak
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or outdoor grill over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until beef is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Toast pita bread on the grill pan if desired.
Divide pita and skewers between plates. Serve with a side of tzatziki and enjoy!
